headline: Out-of-order block merge hint test moved within db_test.go
reason: Test-only relocation of an existing test with an adjusted doc comment; no production code and no assertions changed.
summary: TestOutOfOrderBlockMergePreservesHint is re-added at a new position in tsdb/db_test.go, and its doc comment now says it was copied from PR #19016. The body matches the version removed from the other location, so the same assertions run. It only checks that merged all-out-of-order blocks keep the hint and that WAL-only data survives reload, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
